Which accounts in a row's log are the channel

log_channel_accounts.Rd

The authors of the events that wrote a field only the channel writes, register_channel_fields(). No configuration names the account that holds the round's token, and none is needed: on any row the round has applied the log carries at least the write of its seal, and that write is signed by that account.

Usage

log_channel_accounts(events, record)

Arguments

events

The event log, as register_log() returns it.

record

The record id to look at.

Value

A character vector of usernames, empty when no event wrote one of those fields.

Details

It has to be recognized by the account and not by the event. REDCap logs only the fields an import changed, so when the round writes back a username it resolved and the verdict has not moved, the event carries username alone – an intent field, written by the channel, with nothing in the event itself to say so.
